$Comment:
The leg piece of the woodcutter's kit: a four-piece leather set paid only by the chance rolls in Lootables/Mmo_Woodcutters_Kit.json, one of the four tables behind the Trim Work daily, so the set is collected day by day at the mill rather than bought or crafted. It is a standalone copy of the vanilla soft leather breeches (Armor_Leather_Soft_Legs): the same icon, model and texture, the same Health line and the same Physical and Projectile resistances, at Uncommon quality, item level 30 and MaxDurability 180 in place of the vanilla piece's Common, 10 and 120. No Parent and no Recipe, so no vanilla crafting or salvage recipe can be inherited and the piece stays reward-only. Everything the vanilla breeches take from their own iron parent is spelled out here for the same reason: Categories, the Block animation set, the leather sound set, DurabilityLossOnHit, the Tags, and the Interactions block whose Primary and Secondary each run an EquipItem step. That block is what makes the piece wearable at all, so keep it if you copy this file for a piece of your own.

The stats live in Armor.StatModifiers beside the vanilla Health line and the ENGINE applies them while the piece is worn, exactly as it applies the Health. This is the one piece of the four that carries no Crafting experience bonus: MMO_BonusXp_WOODCUTTING 10 is plus 10 percent Woodcutting experience, multiplied into every Woodcutting award the MMO pays out, sawmill cycles included; MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING 10 is plus 10 percentage points of Woodcutting luck, feeding the MMO's luck ladders and every scored roll this pack ships; Stamina 1 is a flat addition to the wearer's MAXIMUM stamina, the native stat every guard and sprint drains, and needs no MMO prefix because it is Hytale's own. Percent-family MMO stats author their PERCENT as the Amount, and every entry is Additive on purpose: these channels carry a base of zero, and additive folds before multiplicative, so a Multiplicative-only entry here would compute zero and be silently inert.

Worn together the four pieces add plus 33 percent Woodcutting experience, plus 23 percent Crafting experience, plus 43 points of Woodcutting luck and plus 3 maximum stamina, on top of the Health and resistances each piece carries on its own: more Woodcutting experience and more Woodcutting luck than any single hatchet in this pack gives while held, though only the mill's own two hatchets add more stamina than that. The kit is four armor slots given over to the trade, and whatever combat armor would otherwise have sat there. All amounts are opening balance and tunable without an engine change.
